The return is due by 11:59 p.m. on May 1 with no extension; file and amend later to avoid a 10% late penalty. The Treasurer bills in August, due September 5.

items.title: File Virginia Beach business tangible personal property return
items.authority: Virginia Beach Commissioner of the Revenue
items.description: Every taxpayer operating a business in Virginia Beach on January 1 files a tangible personal property return (form CR-13) by March 1; a late filing can bring a penalty or a summons. A written extension request made by March 1 can add up to 90 days.

items.title: Renew the City of Virginia Beach business license (BPOL)
items.authority: Virginia Beach Commissioner of the Revenue
items.description: Renewal returns are mailed in early January and payment is due by March 1; unpaid after that, the business is considered unlicensed and penalty and interest may apply (city guide from 2022).

feeDetail.note: The applicable authority sets fees by license or permit type; confirm the current schedule before filing.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.
